entry.author: Environment Canterbury
entry.summary: How did wallabies spread so far, and what happens when no one steps in? This video reflects on how the removal of coordinated management allowed wallabies to escape control, spreading across thousands of hectares of ideal habitat. Once established, the challenge becomes far more difficult and costly. A new, collaborative approach is changing that story. By working together - landowners, government agencies, conservation groups, and Treaty partners, a moving front has been created to tackle wallabies head-on, with real progress already being made. When responsibility is shared, results follow.
